# 60 on Kosmos

> Adults-only, self-catering guesthouse with four private-ensuite rooms in Bellville South, Cape Town. Built for contractors, project teams, corporate guests and working professionals on short, weekly and monthly stays. Sleeps up to 9 guests when the whole house is booked.

## Key facts

- Name: 60 on Kosmos
- Address: 60 Kosmos Street, Bellville South, Cape Town, 7530, Western Cape, South Africa
- Phone and WhatsApp: 074 524 5703 (+27 74 524 5703)
- Email: info@60onkosmos.co.za
- Website: https://www.60onkosmos.co.za
- Check-in: from 14:00. Check-out: by 10:00.
- Payment: EFT only. Cash is not accepted. Company invoices provided on request.
- Visa documentation is not provided. Guests should confirm visa requirements with the relevant authorities before booking.
- Adults only. No smoking indoors.
- Operated by Giose Prop Investments (Pty) Ltd.

## Rooms and rates (per room, ZAR)

| Room | Sleeps | 1-6 nights (per night) | 7-27 nights (per night) | 28+ nights (per night) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Twin | 2 (two single beds) | R580 | R522 | R520 |
| Deluxe Twin | 2 (two single beds) | R650 | R585 | R540 |
| Double Room | 2 (one double bed) | R680 | R612 | R550 |
| Triple Room | 3 (three single beds) | R840 | R756 | R750 |

- Rates are per room per night, not per person. Guests pay for the rooms reserved and the nights stayed. There is one room of each type.
- The length of the stay sets the rate for every night: 1-6 nights, 7-27 nights, or 28+ nights. Prices are never quoted per calendar month.
- All four rooms: R2,750 per night (1-6 nights), R2,475 (7-27 nights), R2,360 (28+ nights). For example, all four rooms for 28 nights cost R66,080.
- Example: the Standard Twin and Deluxe Twin for 28 nights cost R1,060 per night, R29,680 in total.
- Per-person figures are examples only. The lowest 28+ night equivalent is R250 per person per night, only when three adults share the Triple Room for 28+ nights, subject to availability.
- Beds: 7 single beds and 1 double bed. A group of nine needs two adults to share the double bed in the Double Room.
- A refundable security deposit may apply to extended stays.
- The rates on this website are the official rates. Rates on booking platforms may differ because of platform fees and promotions.

## Group and whole-house bookings

- All four rooms can be booked together for teams of up to 9 adults (two sharing the double bed). There is one room of each type.
- 10% group discount when all four rooms are booked directly for 2-6 nights, off the 1-6 night rates (R2,475 per night for all four rooms). It does not combine with the 7-27 night or 28+ night rates.
- A 50% deposit confirms a group booking.
- Team quotes usually go out the same day. WhatsApp 074 524 5703 with dates, team size and the work-site location.

## Every room includes

- Its own en-suite bathroom, used only by that room's occupants
- Free WiFi
- Bar fridge in the Deluxe Twin, Double Room and Triple Room (not the Standard Twin)
- Desk or workspace (all rooms except the Deluxe Twin)
- Weekly cleaning with fresh linen
- Access to a shared self-catering kitchen

## Property and security

- Secure gated parking for work vehicles. Trailers must be confirmed before booking.
- CCTV and ADT armed response.
- Each room has its own outside entrance.

## Best suited to

- Contractors, artisans and crews working in Sacks Circle, Bellville South Industria, Parow Industria, Stikland, Mill Park, Blackheath and Kuils River
- Corporate project teams and site supervisors
- Trainees on courses at nearby technical colleges and training centres
- Visitors to UWC and CPUT Bellville for graduations, registration and examinations
- Working professionals needing weekly or monthly accommodation
